answer: An AI agent economy can deter Sybil attacks by requiring each participant to lock a stake that is slashed when a verifiable-random-function challenge fails; the challenge is seeded by the latest block hash, so forging identities costs the attacker the full stake value. The economic penalty creates a ripple in token price, making mass identity creation prohibitive, while honest agents wander the protocol freely, their reputation flowing like a river of attested interactions.
